findings.title: Playwright networkidle Synchronization Timeout with Next.js Turbopack HMR Streams
findings.evidence: In tests/phase7-admin-workflows.test.mjs, using page.waitForLoadState('networkidle') caused Playwright to time out (30000ms) because Next.js Turbopack keeps an active server-sent event / WebSocket connection open for Fast Refresh telemetry and HMR. The network never drops to 0 active connections.
findings.exploitability_impact: Medium test stability blocker. Prevents automated browser test suites from completing synchronously under Next.js Turbopack dev environments.
findings.before_behavior: Test awaited networkidle after form submit, hanging until timeout.
findings.after_behavior: Replaced networkidle with explicit Playwright locator readiness checks (locator.waitFor({ state: 'visible' })) and deterministic URL transitions (page.waitForURL()).
findings.remediation: Updated all 9 specifications in tests/phase7-admin-workflows.test.mjs to use strict locator and URL assertions.

findings.title: Strict Mode Locator Ambiguity on Repeated Fixture Title Seeds
findings.evidence: Playwright strict mode threw locator errors in SPEC-04 and SPEC-05 when finding duplicate elements matching 'Draft Computer Science Exam (Sequence Test)' and 'Question Sequence', due to multiple test runs accumulating disposable rows in the test database.
findings.exploitability_impact: Low test fragility. Caused test failure when run against non-truncated test databases.
findings.before_behavior: Used getByText() and getByRole() without .first() disambiguation.
findings.after_behavior: Added .first() disambiguation to locator queries in SPEC-04 and SPEC-05, ensuring strict mode compliance across repeated test executions.

findings.title: Windows Child Process Tree Orphan on Next.js Test Server Teardown
findings.evidence: On Windows, calling nextProcess.kill('SIGTERM') terminates the top-level process handle but leaves spawned cmd.exe and node.exe workers alive, preventing Node.js from exiting cleanly after test completion.
findings.exploitability_impact: Low operator friction. Kept background Node.js processes hanging in PowerShell.
findings.before_behavior: Used nextProcess.kill('SIGTERM'), leaving orphan node processes on Windows.
findings.after_behavior: Added taskkill /F /T /PID ${nextProcess.pid} tree-kill execution in the finally block followed by explicit process.exit().
